clusters.name: foundation
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-001 widens types and schemas used by every downstream story; must land first as the foundation. Cannot parallelize with anything in phase 1.

clusters.name: pure-helpers
clusters.executionModeRationale: Both stories create independent pure-function helpers in distinct files with zero file overlap. Safe to run in parallel once foundation lands.

clusters.name: wiring
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-004 imports the helpers from US-002+US-003 and modifies sync-core.mjs (a high-touch shared file). Cannot start until both phase-2 stories are complete.

clusters.name: ui
clusters.executionModeRationale: UI changes only need the widened types from US-001 (foundation). The UI reads ralphState (already populated by Plan 03), not the new JSON files directly, so it does not depend on US-002/003/004. Can run in parallel with the wiring cluster.

clusters.name: cascade
clusters.executionModeRationale: Cascade audit must run LAST because it verifies the entire implementation against downstream references. Cannot parallelize with anything; must serialize after wiring + ui converge. High concurrent-collision risk on shared plan markdown requires the parallel-safety scan before any edit.
